h: Atiku criticises reports of security agents guarding Tinubu campaign banners in Kaduna
p: Atiku Abubakar has reportedly criticised claims that security personnel were stationed to protect APC campaign banners in Kaduna. The former vice-president, now a leading opposition figure, said public security resources should not be used for party materials. There has been no official response from the APC or the security agencies in the reports seen so far.
more: Campaign banners have become a flashpoint as parties step up activity ahead of 2027.
The APC has not commented in the reports seen so far.
